title: UG-031 — How to enable WCAG-compliant mode for a survey
intent: Explain where the WCAG setting is enabled and what it changes.
short_answer: Enable the WCAG-compliant questionnaire setting on the survey Properties page under Appearance. When participants open the WCAG-compliant questionnaire, the initial layout uses Enhanced Contrast and multiple choice lists are changed into radio buttons.
important_conditions: Participants may change from Enhanced Contrast to Normal view.
All multiple choice lists are changed into radio buttons.
